name: FKN Nuts
description: US snack brand selling spicy seasoned nuts in three heat levels, built around a creator program ('The Heat Squad') for streamers, gamers and food creators on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram.

evidence.summary: FKN Nuts' own affiliate page (fetched) runs applications through Shopify Collabs: creators start at 10% commission on bundles and single bags, climbing lifetime-order tiers to 12% (10 orders), 15% (50 orders) and 20% (150 orders), plus up to $425 in cash bonuses and a free starter box. The page's 'How much can I earn?' answer lists rates and bonuses only — no statement about a cap on total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The program is explicitly creator-first: streamers, YouTube/TikTok creators, Instagram creators, podcasters and gaming communities; approved creators get a link, a 10%-off fan code, reposts on @getfknnuts and features on the brand's socials. Eligibility is US creators aged 21+; no creator-count or cohort-size figure is published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

opportunity.title: FKN Nuts Heat Squad Creator Program (Shopify Collabs)

reasons.niche_fit: A snack brand whose whole go-to-market is short-form creator content — taste tests, reactions and challenges — squarely in the food UGC niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated creator program with tiered perks for posting: starter boxes, monthly free boxes at higher tiers, reposts and social features.
reasons.compensation: 10% base commission published on the brand's own page, rising to 20% at the top lifetime tier, plus cash bonuses; no cap statement is published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A public application route via the official page and Shopify Collabs; no direct program email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open to US creators 21+ of any size ('we care more about an engaged audience than follower count'), reviewed by hand within a few days.
reasons.credibility: Small, young DTC snack brand with a real storefront and a fully documented program page; limited track record compared with legacy brands.

name: Goated Wellness
description: US supplement brand selling creatine, protein, BCAAs and collagen with a direct affiliate program paying a published 15% standard rate (20% VIP) and monthly Zelle payouts with no minimum.

evidence.summary: Goated Wellness' own affiliate page (fetched) states a 15% standard commission and 20% for VIP affiliates on every qualifying order, a personal 20%-off code for the audience, a 30-day referral window, and monthly Zelle payouts from the 1st with no minimum threshold. The page makes no statement about a cap on total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Joining is free, applications are reviewed by the brand's team, and affiliates get a personal dashboard with real-time click, order and commission tracking; the page publishes hello@goatedwellness.com for program questions. No creator-count figure is published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Core sports-supplement line (creatine, protein, collagen) aimed at gym and wellness creators — a strong fit for fitness UGC.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured direct affiliate program with personal codes and dashboards; less creator-content-specific than ambassador-style programs.
reasons.compensation: 15% standard and 20% VIP rates published on the brand's own page, with no-minimum monthly payouts; no cap statement published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Published program email (hello@goatedwellness.com) plus an on-site application.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join with team review of applications; no follower minimum is stated.
reasons.credibility: Small DTC supplement brand with a complete, transparent program page; limited public track record.

The 25% program average is recorded. The page makes no statement about a cap on total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The page publishes affiliates@alorilife.com for partnership questions and custom codes, promises approvals within 48 hours, and states there is no audience-size requirement — partners are approved on fit and engagement. No creator-count figure is published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Women's hormone and cycle wellness is a high-engagement creator niche, and the brand explicitly recruits creators who talk about hormones, mood and burnout.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-first partner program: custom vanity codes, sample access for approved partners, a photo/b-roll library and approved talking points.
reasons.compensation: Commissions averaging over 25% published on the brand's own page, with tiered bonuses above that; no cap statement published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliates email plus a five-minute Awin application linked from the brand's own partner page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join, no follower minimum, approvals typically within 48 hours.
reasons.credibility: Young, small DTC brand; the program page is detailed and transparent, but the company has a limited public track record.

name: Gorilla Mind
description: Performance supplement brand (pre-workout, nootropics, protein and energy drinks) with a large creator community, running a direct Ambassador Program paying 20% commission in cash on every referred sale.

evidence.summary: Gorilla Mind's own ambassador page (fetched) states ambassadors earn 20% commission on every sale they refer, paid in cash, with a personal promo code (10% off for followers), a custom referral link, a welcome box and a pathway to sponsored Athlete status. The page makes no statement about a cap on total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Minimum requirements are published: at least 750 followers on Instagram or TikTok, 20+ total posts and 4+ posts per month, with applications reviewed in 2-4 weeks — an entry threshold, not a cohort size, so saturation is recorded as unknown. reasons.niche_fit: One of the most creator-driven supplement brands in fitness; its products are designed to be reviewed, compared and demonstrated on camera.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal ambassador program with content requirements, a welcome box, a private community and an athlete pathway — deep UGC infrastructure.
reasons.compensation: 20% commission paid in cash on every referred sale, published on the brand's own page; no cap statement published, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A defined application page with published requirements and review timelines; no direct program email is published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application but gated: 750+ followers, 20+ posts, 4+ posts/month, and a 2-4 week review.
reasons.credibility: Major DTC supplement brand with a ~450K-follower Instagram presence and a long-running athlete/ambassador roster.

reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator tier with starter kits, an asset library, campaign briefs and QR class cards — real UGC support, not just a link.
reasons.compensation: 20% first-order commission at the base tier (25% for creators with 2,000+ engaged followers) plus 16-18% on each customer's next four orders, published in full program terms; no cap statement published, so the cap stays unknown.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join, open worldwide, individual review within 3 business days; the store ships within the US.
reasons.credibility: The brand cites 35+ years of Ayurvedic expertise and 4,600+ customer reviews on its own program page.
